draft-handoff:tkt-p13-active.note: Port 13 on SW-C4-01 is still flapping. I've reseated the cable at both ends twice this shift and each time the link only held briefly. There's a visible kink near the connector, so I put in a request for a replacement Cat6A (ETA tomorrow morning). This is the 7th link-flap ticket on this port in 30 days, so the cable is the likely culprit. Sam, please do the swap when the cable arrives, then watch the port for an hour; if it still flaps, move the uplink to a spare port.
